before_html: If you weren’t loved well as a child, “love your inner child” can sound like nonsense. Love them how? Maybe you really want the best for your little one. Maybe you hug them in your imagination, or miss them. And you can still feel none of the warmth people mean when they say love. That doesn’t close the door, though, it just means you start smaller.

before_html: If the love still isn’t coming, you can at least stop judging your little one. Obviously no insults. Helpful advice is great, we all need advice. Let them absorb it at their pace. And don’t expect a thank-you for the session, like they booked it. That’s enough to start being the adult, even if it isn’t enough yet for them to trust you.

before_html: Taking the hostility out makes room for warmth. What people most often say helped is letting their defenses down. I mean by choice, after the part guarding you has been heard. If you’ve never been safe being loved, your ego can act like a rigid security guard that won’t let the feeling in, and being vulnerable is the opening the feeling needs. (This guard is only about letting the feeling in. People still have to earn your trust.) Sometimes the warmth is there, with a cold part standing in front of it, guarding something. That part tends to step aside once it’s been heard (see the section Hear the Protective Part First).

before_html: Some people have the opposite problem. It feels like you’re connecting with your little one, but the contact is staying near the surface. Meditating for a long time and then sleeping can open up much more emotionally direct stuff, especially in a second sleep, after you’ve already slept once. What showed me that the daytime pl/ork had stayed shallow was the difference at night. So say you wake up from a dream with far more feeling and need in it than the session came anywhere near. That’s the sign this is you (a session that was good and just didn’t stick around is something else). Then ask what that dream let you feel that the session didn’t, and how you understand it now. And if nightmares start wrecking your sleep, do less of the practice, earlier in the day or for a shorter time, before you write off the whole thing.
